[package]

description = "Api bindings for the Bitwarden API."
categories = ["api-bindings"]
version = "4.0.0"
authors = ["Bitwarden Inc"]
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.88.0"
homepage = "https://bitwarden.com"
repository = "https://github.com/bitwarden/sdk-internal"
license = "GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Bitwarden-SDK"
keywords = ["bitwarden"]

[features]
mockall = ["dep:mockall"]

[dependencies]
async-trait = ">=0.1.80, <0.2"
serde_json = ">=1.0.96, <2.0"
url = ">=2.5, <3"

[dependencies.bitwarden-api-base]
path = "crates/bitwarden-api-base"
version = "=4.0.0"

[dependencies.mockall]
optional = true
version = ">=0.13.1, <0.16"

[dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.13.3"
features = ["json", "multipart", "http2", "form", "query"]
default-features = false

[dependencies.reqwest-middleware]
version = "0.5.1"
features = ["json", "multipart", "form", "query"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = ">=1.0, <2.0"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.serde_with]
version = ">=3.8, <4"
default-features = false
features = ["base64", "std", "macros"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = ">=1.3.3, <2.0"
features = ["serde", "v4", "js"]

[package]
name = "bitwarden-api-base"
description = "Internal crate for the bitwarden crate. Do not use.\n"

homepage = "https://bitwarden.com"
repository = "https://github.com/bitwarden/sdk-internal"
license = "GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Bitwarden-SDK"
keywords = ["bitwarden"]

[features]
uniffi = ["dep:bitwarden-uniffi-error", "dep:uniffi"]

[dependencies]
http = ">=1.4.0, <2"

url = ">=2.5, <3"

[dependencies.bitwarden-uniffi-error]
optional = true
path = "crates/bitwarden-uniffi-error"
version = "=4.0.0"

[dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.13.3"
features = ["json", "multipart", "http2", "form", "query"]
default-features = false

[dependencies.reqwest-middleware]
version = "0.5.1"
features = ["json", "multipart", "form", "query"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = ">=1.0, <2.0"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.uniffi]
optional = true
version = "=0.32.0"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch=\"wasm32\"))".dependencies]
rustls-platform-verifier = "0.7.0"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch=\"wasm32\"))".dependencies.reqwest]
features = ["rustls-no-provider", "json", "multipart", "http2", "form", "query"]
version = "0.13.3"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(not(target_arch=\"wasm32\"))".dependencies.rustls]
version = "0.23.27"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "tls12", "logging", "ring"]

[lints.clippy]
disallowed-macros = "deny"
unused_async = "warn"
unwrap_used = "deny"
string_slice = "warn"
print_stdout = "warn"
print_stderr = "warn"
result_unit_err = "allow"
chunks_exact_to_as_chunks = "allow"

[lints.rust]
missing_docs = "warn"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(feature, values(\"uniffi\", \"wasm\"))", "cfg(dylint_lib, values(\"bitwarden_lints\"))", "cfg(bitwarden_ensure_non_commercial)"]
